services.desc: The Rotary Hall is a timber framed hall with wooden floors, an expansive ocean view, an outdoor balcony, surround sound and AV capabilities. The room has a separate entrance and an option to rent adjacent kitchen and mezzanine areas. It’s perfect for weddings, corporate functions, concerts, celebrations of life, holiday events and more. The maximum capacity of Rotary Hall is 146 people seated at tables or 180 theatre style. We also have a fully equipped kitchen to accommodate your catering requirements available for rent.
